title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Vina Robles Amphitheatre, Paso Robles | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Vina Robles Amphitheatre in Paso Robles, California, USA, on 31 August 2019.

It was the penultimate show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

Starr had previously performed at the Vina Robles Amphitheatre on 2 October 2015. He returned there on 16 June 2023 and 6 June 2026.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
